user.description: Connect to your HB-RF-ETH gateway. Use the host (or the mDNS name like hb-rf-eth-xxxxxx.local) plus the WebUI credentials of the device.

reauth_confirm.description: The gateway at {host} rejected the stored credentials (password changed?). Enter the new WebUI password.

backup.name: Create backup
backup.description: Downloads the full settings backup (including credentials and certificates) into the hb_rf_eth_backups folder of your configuration directory. Treat the file as a secret.

restore.name: Restore backup
restore.description: Restores a settings backup previously created by the backup service.

download_log.name: Download system log
download_log.description: Downloads the complete captured system log into the hb_rf_eth_backups folder.

restart.name: Restart gateway
restart.description: Restarts the gateway. The CCU reconnects automatically.

update_check.name: Check for updates
update_check.description: Starts a manual update search on the gateway.
